# Sylvane

> > Sylvane is a 25+ year trusted online retailer specializing in indoor air quality solutions, dehumidifiers, and humidity control products for residential and commercial applications.

Sylvane offers a comprehensive catalog of dehumidifiers from leading brands including Santa Fe, Aprilaire, Friedrich, Honeywell, and Midea, serving homeowners, businesses, and contractors. The company provides expert guidance on humidity control, energy-efficient solutions, and whole-house moisture management systems.

## Dehumidifier Collections

- [High Performance Dehumidifiers for Home & Basement Use](https://www.sylvane.com/collections/dehumidifiers): Main dehumidifier collection with Santa Fe, Friedrich, Frigidaire brands

- [Basement Dehumidifiers | 35-130 Pint Models Available](https://www.sylvane.com/collections/basement-dehumidifiers): Basement dehumidifiers: 35-130 pint Energy Star models for crawl spaces
- [Crawl Space Dehumidifiers | 70-198 Pint Models Available](https://www.sylvane.com/collections/crawl-space-dehumidifiers): Crawl space dehumidifiers: 70-198 pint Energy Star models
- [Dehumidifiers with Built-In Pump | Ideal For Large Rooms](https://www.sylvane.com/collections/dehumidifiers-with-pump): Dehumidifiers with built-in pumps for large rooms and basements
- [Energy Star Dehumidifiers | Save Energy & Reduce Humidity](https://www.sylvane.com/collections/energy-star-dehumidifiers): Energy Star-rated dehumidifiers for efficiency and cost savings
